title: Hangar OAV
subtitle: Zigzag walks the ships, outside and in.
disclaimer: Stylized fan mockup — not an official film.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: Start with the shuttle. Wings fold up in the bay, then they lock open and the hull becomes a dart.

beats.label: Ramp
beats.text: The ramp is down. Warm light from the hangar, cold light from the cabin. This is how you come aboard.

beats.label: Cabin
beats.text: Four seats, ribs in the ceiling, a short walk to the flight deck. The cabin is the whole passenger ship.

beats.label: Cockpit
beats.text: Two seats under the canopy. The board is lit. From here the wings are already locked.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: Four foils on a cross. They sit shut for the cruise, then snap into an X when the pilot commits.

beats.label: Cockpit
beats.text: One seat, a canopy, and a board you can reach without standing. The fighter is a cockpit with wings.

beats.label: Socket
beats.text: Behind the seat is the socket. A dome droid rides there and talks to the ship through the bulkhead.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: A ball cockpit and two hex wings. No shields on this one. The pilot sits in the middle and trusts the frame.

beats.label: Seat
beats.text: Inside the ball there is a seat, a viewport, and not much else. The whole ship is this room.

beats.label: Panels
beats.text: Panels wrap the sphere. Life support, guns, and the wings are all an arm's length from the pilot.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: The armor is gone. What is left is a cockpit, a neck, and two long engines. It looks stripped because it is.

beats.label: Pilot
beats.text: The pilot sits forward under a short canopy. The board is close. The engines are behind you and loud.

beats.label: Gunner
beats.text: Turn around. The second seat faces aft. That is the gunner's station, looking back down the neck.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: Saucer, split mandibles, cockpit off to the side. The dish on the spine is the tell. This freighter is faster than it looks.

beats.label: Ramp
beats.text: Boarding ramp under the nose. You come up into the saucer, not a corridor. The ship is one big room with pockets.

beats.label: Hold
beats.text: The hold is crates, scuffed deck, and enough height to stand. Freight lives here when it is not people.

beats.label: Lounge
beats.text: A round table and a few seats. This is the lounge. The ship does its talking here.

beats.label: Cockpit
beats.text: The cockpit is a tube off the starboard side. Two seats, a board, and windows that are not on the centerline.

beats.label: Engineering
beats.text: Aft is the engine bay. The glow is the drive. You can stand here and feel the whole saucer pointed forward.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: Step back. The wedge only reads when you give it room. The tower sits aft, and the engines light the stern.

beats.label: Bridge
beats.text: The bridge is a wide room of consoles and a viewport. Crew pits face the glass. The wedge flies from here.

beats.label: Corridor
beats.text: A ribbed corridor runs aft of the bridge. The ship is mostly hallways like this, then a room that matters.

beats.label: Hangar bay
beats.text: The bay is the hollow in the belly. A shuttle can sit on the deck. The doors open onto black.

beats.label: Hull
beats.text: A sphere, a trench around the middle, and a dish on the face. Now we go inside the station.

beats.label: Corridor
beats.text: The inside is a corridor with a red line in the deck. The station is hallways until it is a weapon.

beats.label: Gallery
beats.text: The gallery looks into the dish. That orange well is the superlaser face, seen from the safe side of the glass.

beats.label: Dock
beats.text: A dock big enough for a shuttle. You can walk off a ship and into the station without ever seeing the hull.
